recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-11481 unless the Pharmacy work group opens a new issue asking for substantive medication-error-correction guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-11481 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking that the boilerplate "fixing data" / "Correcting errors" section on the Medications Module page either be completed or removed. The recorded resolution was to remove the section.
initial_application:
SVN-derived commit 63eb75e588d983403821e1088dd962e1e9227cf4, "#11481 and #11479 - updated Medications Module", appears to be the initial application. Its git-svn id points to build@9953, matching the Jira comment, and its patch removes the

Correcting errors

placeholder and boilerplate paragraph from source/medications-module.html.
additional_context: Current source/medications-module.html remains the active medications module source and has been substantially revised by later commits, but it does not reintroduce the removed placeholder. Jira search for the exact fixing-data medications-module phrase returned only FHIR-11481. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting discussion or minutes. FHIR-11479 was applied in the same historical commit but concerned a separate Common Use Cases planning/CarePlan update.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the requested removal is already present in current source, and adding replacement guidance would exceed or contradict the issue's published remove-section resolution.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same historical SVN-derived commit, but it concerned adding planning/CarePlan to Common Use Cases rather than the removed fixing-data boilerplate, so it was not decided here.
